text:
Maya Chen: quick q — noticed new fields in the /v1/usage response: billable_prompt_tokens, billable_completion_tokens, cached_tokens_count, token_origin. How should clients interpret these w/ streaming + prefix cache? e.g., when streaming, do we emit interim increments or only final totals? and what's the contract for backward compatibility?

Luis Ortega: good q. current plan (per PR #4321) — we send interim 'streamed_token_delta' events while streaming, and then a final 'billing_summary' event containing the 4 fields. non-streaming requests get the billing_summary in the response body as usual. legacy clients that only read the first HTTP header/initial payload will still get an x-rw-estimated-billable header as a best-effort estimate.

Priya Patel: short definitions to avoid confusion: token_origin can be one of: 'prompt', 'completion', 'cache', 'system'. cached_tokens_count = number of tokens served from KV cache. billable_* fields are the billed units after honoring cache discounts (so cached tokens are NOT double-billed). Example final event we plan to emit: 
```json
{"billing_summary": {"billable_prompt_tokens": 34, "billable_completion_tokens": 12, "cached_tokens_count": 20, "token_origin": "mixed"}}
```
Note: we put this nested under billing_summary to leave room for future fields.

Sam Wu: a clarification on partial/fallback flows — if a request starts from cache (prefix hits) then falls back to model mid-stream, you will see multiple streamed_token_delta events with origin tags, e.g. origin:cache then origin:completion. The final billing_summary will sum those into billable_prompt/completion and include cached_tokens_count separately. For older clients, rely on x-rw-estimated-billable in the initial headers; that is approximate.

billing-bot: NOTE: committed-capacity customers will have cached tokens excluded from metered billing but they will still appear in telemetry for debugging/reconciliation. See: <https://redwood/docs/billing/cached-tokens> for policy and examples.

Evelyn Park: action items: 1) eng-platform: add unit + integr tests for streaming billing events (owners @luis @maya) 2) docs: add explicit compatibility section + examples (owner @priya) 3) SDKs: add helper parsers for merging streamed_token_delta -> billing_summary (owner @sam). Can we get a PR with tests by EOD Friday? :calendar:  Also, confirm format: nested 'billing_summary' object vs flat top-level fields — leaning nested.

Maya Chen: ok i'll open the PR + write unit tests. one quick check — should the billing_summary be the only place we put billable_* fields or also mirror as top-level for easier parsing?

Luis Ortega: nested only. We'll avoid mirroring to reduce ambiguity. If SDKs need convenience helpers we can add those to official SDKs.

Priya Patel: I'll update the OpenAPI spec and add a migration note in the API changelog.

Sam Wu: will add JS + Python helpers: streaming merge util + finalizer that validates billing_summary sums match streamed deltas. Also will add a migration note in the SDK changelog.

Maya Chen: thanks all — tagging @billing-bot so finance sees the policy note. Leaving this for async follow-up. :thumbsup:
